clips.title: The story
paras: Sida's Bag is the personal satchel of Sida, a resident of Menethil Harbor. Swallowed whole by a creeping ooze during her excursion to Ironbeard's Tomb, the bag and its mysterious contents require a thorough hunt through the acidic slimes of the Wetlands to recover.

While paying her regular weekly visit to Ironbeard's Tomb near Dun Modr, Sida found herself ambushed by the dreadful, dripping oozes that infest the area. Panicking in the face of the encroaching sludge, she flung her personal satchel directly at one of the creatures. Rather than driving the beast off, the ooze simply absorbed the bag into its gelatinous body. The distraction bought Sida enough precious moments to flee with her life back to the safety of Menethil Harbor, leaving her possessions trapped inside an unknown slime.

Because the undulating oozes prowling Ironbeard's Tomb—ranging from crimson to monstrous varieties—look largely identical, finding the bag requires cutting down the marsh slimes until the swallowed satchel emerges intact. Despite soaking within acidic digestive muck, the durable sack preserves its contents. Once returned to Sida, she eagerly reclaims her belongings and discards the ruined, slime-coated exterior, offering the washed-out container to whoever braved the marsh on her behalf.
